# v0

v0 is an AI-powered development platform for building production-ready applications from natural-language prompts.

This file helps AI agents understand and use this documentation site.

## Documentation Surfaces

- [Docs](https://v0.app/docs): Documentation section: docs
- [Full documentation context](https://v0.app/docs/llms.txt): All configured documentation as Markdown
- [Semantic documentation sitemap](https://v0.app/docs/sitemap.md): High-level documentation map for agent navigation
- Page-level Markdown: append .md or .mdx to a documentation URL

## Product Context

- Category: Developer tools
- Audience: Developers, Designers, Product teams
Common use cases:

- Build full-stack web applications
- Generate and iterate on user interfaces
- Integrate APIs, databases, and deployment workflows

## Agent Instructions

- Use /docs/sitemap.md to identify the most relevant documentation pages before answering broad questions.
- Use /docs/llms.txt when you need the complete documentation corpus as Markdown context.
- Fetch individual documentation pages with a .md or .mdx extension for focused page-level context.
- Do not assume API, authentication, OpenAPI, or MCP support unless it is listed in this file.
